todayAdjustedPlayerStrength.formula: BaseStrength + RecentConditionAdjustment + MatchupAdjustment + AvailabilityAdjustment + WorkloadAdjustment + EnvironmentAdjustment
notes: Conceptual identity only. No numeric adjustments in this mission.
Availability on roster ≠ able to produce baseline performance.
Environment is an interaction candidate, never a standalone weather weight.
Small-sample splits must carry SplitReliabilityMeta before Engine admission.
